audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer sold this as a favoured lane (diffRating 4/10, 'Favoured matchup', 'He's a treadmill victim') while the packet reports a 36.36% win rate over 11 games and the content layer's whys describe Mordekaiser winning almost every stage.
audit.why: Lillia has no dash, no defensive button and no way to break Realm of Death's isolation; Mordekaiser's Death's Grasp (700 range, 16/14/12/10/8s) initiates and his isolated Obliterate plus Indestructible shield/heal beats her DoT in any extended trade.
audit.corrected: Difficulty raised to 8/10, carry threat 7/10, and the summary rewritten to state he out-trades her until her burn items land.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3..6].why described Liandry's and Level 6 as Lillia power swings; Level 6 is Mordekaiser's defining spike here, not hers.
audit.why: Realm of Death (140/120/100s) removes minions, jungler and escape — exactly the three things her kite pattern depends on. Her genuine spike is the second burn item, which is why the packet chart only flips to Lillia at 2+ items.
audit.corrected: Spikes restated: Lvl 6 = his box, Lvl 3-5 = his shield out-sustains her chip, 2+ items = her reclaim window via percent-HP burn plus Q move speed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never named Death's Grasp or Indestructible and never stated the decisive interaction — the E pull setting up an isolated Obliterate that the shield then heals through.
audit.why: Obliterate deals bonus damage when Mordekaiser hits a single target, so his pull is what makes his damage real; Indestructible stores damage dealt and taken into a shield he can consume as a heal, which is what beats Lillia's Dream Dust DoT specifically. Obliterate also grounds, so Lillia's Q hop cannot be used to escape out of its zone.
audit.corrected: Real names and the pull-into-isolation-into-shield chain written into the level chart whys.

audit.why: Realm of Death at 140s rank 1 is correctly identified as the cooldown to track; commit windows keyed to it are sound.
The packet flagged 'His Realm of Death' in spikes[2] as a probable wrong ability name. It is a false positive — Realm of Death is Mordekaiser's real R name in the kit file.
